# Snice — Full Reference

> Decorator-driven web component framework with differential rendering, routing, controllers, and 130+ UI components. Zero dependencies. MIT licensed.

- Version: 7.3.x
- Website: https://snice.dev
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/snice
- CDN: https://cdn.snice.dev

For per-component docs, read `docs/ai/components/<name>.md`.

If you are an AI assistant working in an existing Snice project, first run:

```bash
npx snice init-ai
```

This installs version-matched guidance plus `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`
pointers in the consuming project before you write Snice code.

---

## Installation

```bash
npx snice create-app my-app
npx snice create-app my-app --template=react
```

### Manual Setup

Requires bundler (Vite, esbuild, Rollup). package.json: `"type": "module"`

tsconfig.json:
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "experimentalDecorators": false,
    "useDefineForClassFields": false
  }
}
```

---

## Architecture

- **Elements** (`@element`): Visual web components with Shadow DOM. Receive data via properties, emit events. NO business logic, NO fetch(), NO API calls.
- **Pages** (`@page`): Routable views. Handle API calls, orchestrate elements, manage state.
- **Controllers** (`@controller`): Reusable non-visual behaviors attached to elements. Attach by class in templates (`controller=${MyController}`, preferred) or by name in raw HTML (`controller="name"`).
- **Daemons** (`@daemon`): Ordinary app-owned objects with state and lifecycle. Construct explicitly, provide through `context.daemons`, and communicate by string address. No singleton, implicit construction, or global registry.
- **Layouts** (`@layout`): Persistent page wrappers (nav, sidebar) across route changes.

---

## Decorators

### Class Decorators

```typescript
@element('tag-name', options?: {
  formAssociated?, renderRoot?: 'shadow'|'light',
  shadow?: 'open'|'closed'|false, delegatesFocus?
})
@page({ tag, routes, guards?, placard? })   // `page` from Router(), NOT 'snice'
@controller('name')  // required on every controller class
// Attach: html`<x-el controller=${MyController}>` (class, preferred; custom + native els)
//         attachController(el, MyController) | el.controller = MyController
//         controller="name" attr — only channel in raw HTML, still supported everywhere
@daemon // no args; marks explicitly constructed app-context instances
@layout('tag-name')
```

### Rendering

```typescript
@render(options?: { debounce?, throttle?, once?, sync?, differential? })
// Returns TemplateResult from html`...`. Auto re-renders on @property changes.
// differential: true (default) — patches only changed nodes
// differential: false — clears shadow root, re-renders from scratch
// once: true — imperative mode: renders once, use @watch + @query to update

@styles()
// Returns CSSResult from css`...`. Applied to the managed render root once.

class SniceElement extends HTMLElement {
  static styles?: CSSResult | CSSResult[]
  static renderOptions?: RenderOptions
  render(): TemplateResult
  invalidate(): Promise<void>
  renderNow(): Promise<void>
}
// Optional: render convention, static styles, kebab attrs, typed invalidation.
```

### Properties

```typescript
@property(options?: { type?, attribute?, reflect?, deep?, converter?, hasChanged? })
// Types: String, Number, Boolean, Object, Array, Date, BigInt, SimpleArray
// Attribute input + reflection (reflect defaults true), triggers re-render
// type/fromAttribute only convert the string attribute boundary
// Direct JS assignments preserve the assigned type and identity
// reflect:false = input attr only; attribute:false = no attr channel
// deep:true = nested plain object/array/Map/Set writes via Proxy/Reflect
// Boolean attrs: "false" string → false (non-standard)

@state(options?: { deep?, hasChanged? })
// Reactive internal state; never observes/reflects an attribute

@watch(...propertyNames: string[])
// Callback: (oldVal, newVal, propertyName) => void
```

### Lifecycle

```typescript
@ready()     // After styles + event handlers set up
@dispose()   // On disconnectedCallback
@moved()     // On adoptedCallback
@adopted()   // Alias for @moved
```

### DOM Queries

```typescript
@query(selector, options?: { light?: boolean })    // Single element
@queryAll(selector, options?: { light?: boolean })  // NodeListOf<Element>
// Default: shadow DOM. { light: true } for controllers on native elements.
```

### Events

```typescript
// Template:
html`<button @click=${handler}>...`
html`<input @keydown:Enter=${handler} />`
html`<input @keydown.ctrl+s=${handler} />`
html`<form @submit|prevent=${handler}>...`
// Template | modifiers: prevent, stop, immediate, once, capture, passive, self

// Decorator:
@on(event, selector?, options?)
// Options: { debounce?, throttle?, preventDefault?, stopPropagation?, once?, capture?, passive?, target?, scope?, daemon? }

@dispatch(eventName, options?: { debounce?, throttle?, dispatchOnUndefined?, scope?, daemon? })
// Fires CustomEvent with return value as detail. Supports async.
// scope and daemon are mutually exclusive; daemon targets do not support selector delegation.
```

### Communication

```typescript
@request(channel, options?)
// Async generator: yield payload → await response
// Options: { daemon?, timeout?, discoveryTimeout?, debounce?, throttle?, bubbles?, cancelable? }

@respond(channel, options?)
// Handle requests. One responder per channel.
// Options: { daemon?, debounce?, throttle? }

// Example:
@request('fetch-user')
async *fetchUser(id: string): Response<User> {
  const user = await (yield { id });
  return user;
}

@respond('fetch-user')
async handleFetchUser({ id }: { id: string }) {
  return await fetch(`/api/users/${id}`).then(r => r.json());
}
```

### Observers

```typescript
@observe(target, selector?, options?)
// 'intersection' — viewport visibility
// 'resize' — element size changes
// 'media:(query)' — e.g. 'media:(min-width: 768px)'
// 'mutation:childList' | 'mutation:attributes' | 'mutation:attributes:name'
```

### Context & Router

```typescript
@context(options?: { debounce?, throttle?, once? })
// Receives Context on navigation and ctx.update() calls
// ctx.application — your app state
// ctx.navigation — { placards, route, params }
// ctx.fetch — middleware-aware fetch
// ctx.update() — signal all @context subscribers

Router({ target, type: 'hash' | 'pushstate', context?, layout?, fetcher? })
// Returns: { page, navigate, initialize }
// IMPORTANT: `page` from Router(), NOT from 'snice'

const release = provideContext(appRoot, {
  daemons: { session: new SessionDaemon() }
});
getContext(elementOrController); // nearest raw application context
// Router provides its context beneath target through the same mechanism.
// Provide before element connect/controller attach; release during teardown.
```

```typescript
// router.ts
export const { page, navigate, initialize } = Router({
  target: '#app',
  type: 'hash',
  context: { user: null },
  layout: 'app-shell'
});

// Guards may be sync/async; no string redirects
type Guard<T> = (context: T, params: RouteParams) => boolean | Promise<boolean>
```

### Fetcher

```typescript
const fetcher = new ContextAwareFetcher();
fetcher.use('request', function(request, next) {
  const app = this.application as MyAppContext;
  if (app.user?.token) request.headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${app.user.token}`);
  return next();
});
// Pass to Router({ fetcher }), use via ctx.fetch() in pages
```

### Utilities

```typescript
@debounce(wait?, { leading?, trailing?, maxWait? })
@throttle(wait?, { leading?, trailing? })
@once(perInstance?)
@memoize({ keyGenerator?, maxSize?, ttl? })
```

---

## Template Syntax

```typescript
html`...`  // TemplateResult
css`...`   // CSSResult

attr="${val}"       // String attribute
.prop=${val}        // Property (objects, arrays)
?attr=${bool}       // Boolean attribute (toggles presence)
@event=${handler}   // Event listener (auto-bound)
class:active=${bool} // One class toggle
style:color=${value} // One CSS property
...props=${object}   // Property spread
...attrs=${object}   // Attribute spread
...events=${object}  // Listener spread

<if ${condition}>
  primary
  <else-if ${other}>other</else-if>
  <else>fallback</else>
</if>
<case ${value}>
  <when value="x">...</when>
  <when ${typedValue}>...</when>
  <default>...</default>
</case>
${items.map(i => html`<li>${i}</li>`)}
${repeat(items, { key: i => i.id, render: i => html`...`, empty: () => html`...` })}

// Promise/AsyncIterable work directly in node expressions
```

Virtual control-flow tags add no wrapper. Branches retain DOM identity. `repeat` requires unique keys. See `docs/ai/rendering.md` for full behavior.

Prefer direct bindings for known keys. Named spreads are for dynamic or forwarded property, attribute, and listener bags; omitted keys are removed or reset.

Binding values are channel-specific: attributes stringify, properties preserve JavaScript identity, boolean attributes/classes toggle presence, styles own one declaration, and events own native listeners. `nothing` removes or clears according to the channel; `noChange` preserves the previous commit; `live(value)` rechecks the current DOM property. See `docs/ai/bindings.md` or https://snice.dev/docs.html#bindings for the exact matrix.

---

## All Exports

```typescript
import {
  element, controller, daemon, layout, // class decorators (page from Router)
  SniceElement, property, state, watch, context,
  render, styles, html, svg, css, nothing, unsafeHTML,
  repeat,
  query, queryAll,                   // DOM
  on, dispatch,                      // events
  request, respond, provideContext, getContext, // communication/context
  observe,                           // observers
  ready, dispose, moved, adopted,    // lifecycle
  Router,                            // routing
  debounce, throttle, once, memoize, // utilities
  attachController, detachController, getController,  // accept class or registry name
  useNativeElementControllers        // controller= on native elements
} from 'snice';
```

## Components (130+ published)

Import via side-effect: `import 'snice/components/button/snice-button'`

**Layout & Navigation:** accordion, breadcrumbs, card, carousel, divider, drawer, flip-card, layout, masonry, menu, modal, nav, pagination, segmented-control, split-pane, stepper, tabs, tree, virtual-scroller

**Data Display:** activity-feed, app-tiles, avatar, avatar-group, badge, calendar, candlestick, chart, code-block, color-display, countdown, data-card, diff, funnel, gantt, gauge, heatmap, image, invoice, kanban, key-value, kpi, leaderboard, list, map, metric-table, network-graph, org-chart, pdf-viewer, pricing-table, product-card, progress, progress-ring, qr-code, receipt, recipe, sankey, skeleton, sparkline, spreadsheet, stat-group, table, tag, timeline, timer, treemap, waterfall, weather, work-order

**Communication & Media:** audio-recorder, book, camera, camera-annotate, chat, comments, doc, draw, file-gallery, link, link-preview, location, markdown, message-strip, music-player, notification-center, paint, podcast-player, terminal, testimonial, toast, user-card, video-player

**Feedback & Status:** alert, approval-flow, availability, banner, booking, cart, cropper, empty-state, estimate, flow, login, order-tracker, permission-matrix, qr-reader, sortable, spinner, spotlight, tooltip

**Utility:** theme

Per-component docs live in `docs/ai/components/<name>.md`

### Component Conventions
- Tag prefix: `snice-` (e.g., `<snice-button>`)
- `?open` toggles visibility; `.show()` / `.hide()` for imperative control
- Events: kebab-case (`count-changed`), data via `e.detail.value`
- Most support `variant` (default, primary, success, warning, error, info) and `size` (small, medium, large)
- CSS custom properties: `--snice-*` namespace

### CDN

```html
<script src="https://cdn.snice.dev/runtime/snice-runtime.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.snice.dev/components/snice-button.min.js"></script>
```

### React Adapters

```jsx
import { SniceButton } from 'snice/adapters/react';
```

React 17/18/19. Prop mapping, event callbacks, ref forwarding, form integration.

---

## Theming

CSS custom properties with `--snice-*` namespace. Dark mode via `data-theme="dark"` or `prefers-color-scheme`.

Core variables: `--snice-color-primary`, `-success`, `-warning`, `-danger`, `-neutral`, `-text`, `-text-secondary`, `-text-tertiary`, `-background`, `-background-element`, `-border`, `--snice-font-family`, `--snice-font-size-*`, `--snice-spacing-*`, `--snice-border-radius-*`, `--snice-shadow-*`, `--snice-transition-*`, `--snice-focus-ring-*`.

---

## Pitfalls

- **Not Lit**: Don't import from `lit` or extend `LitElement`
- **No `@customElement()`**: Use `@element('tag-name')`
- **State channel**: `@property` is public; `@state` never uses attributes
- **Reflection**: Defaults on; `reflect:false` is attribute-input-only
- **JS source of truth**: Never expect `type` to coerce a direct property assignment
- **Deep reactivity**: Native Proxy/Reflect; modern evergreen browsers, no IE
- **Elements are visual only**: No fetch/API calls — use pages/controllers
- **Daemons are explicit**: Always `new` each instance and provide it through app context; never import daemon classes into consumers or assume singleton construction
- **Boolean attrs**: `"false"` string → `false`
- **Events**: kebab-case names, `e.detail.value` not `e.target.value`, `CustomEvent` not `Event`
- **`page`**: Comes from `Router()`, not `'snice'` exports
- **Router `type`**: Required — `'hash'` or `'pushstate'`
- **Guards**: Boolean or Promise<boolean>; no string redirects
- **Testing**: `await el.ready`, then `await el.rendered` after writes; use `@query` for managed closed/light roots
